0022600118.text: The Sacramento Kings (0-2, 4th in the Pacific and 14th in the West) host the Memphis Grizzlies (2-0, 2nd in the Southwest and 5th in the West) in the Kings' third game of the 2026-27 season, looking to end a two-game losing streak. Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), and Murray is averaging 7.0 points and 27.2 minutes this season after 14.0 points and 34.5 minutes last season. Memphis is missing Zach Edey (ankle), with Cedric Coward and Karim Lopez (knee bruise) listed as day-to-day, and the teams have not met yet this season, after the Kings lost the 2025-26 series 1-3 and then won their last meeting 123-114 in Memphis on Feb. 23, 2026.
